common_name: Poco Butter Brickle Red Hot Poker

planting.note: Plant in full sun in average, well-drained soil once frost danger has passed.

directions: A dwarf red hot poker in Terra Nova's Poco series, this cultivar sends up deep butterscotch-gold flower spikes from June right up to frost, held above stiffly upright, grass-like foliage that stays neat even out of bloom. It tolerates heat and humidity well, resists deer browsing, and is a strong hummingbird draw, making it a good fit for mixed containers as well as garden beds. Finish time runs six to eight weeks from liner to a 4-inch pot.
sources: Terra Nova Nurseries (terranovanurseries.com) — Kniphofia POCO 'Butter Brickle' product page

planting.note: Plant in full sun; let soil dry moderately between waterings once established.

directions: Bred as a companion to the earlier 'Pink Pearl', this agastache produces fragrant, peachy-orange flower spikes over a fast, upright-growing clump. It flowers from June through October in full summer sun and shares its parent's resistance to deer browsing and downy mildew, along with a strong pull for hummingbirds and other pollinators. It is best kept on the dry side between waterings rather than grown wet.
sources: Terra Nova Nurseries (terranovanurseries.com) — Agastache 'Peach Pearl' product page
